version.changelog: Simplify the login instructions to the code flow (maton login prints a link; finish with maton login --code <CODE>), drop the API Key subsection, and pin the Maton CLI install to 0.4.0.

llm.summary: This is a disclosed Google Play Developer API integration that uses Maton OAuth and documents user-confirmed writes and automation controls.

dimensions.detail: Network access, Bash, and local read/search tools are proportionate for installing and invoking the CLI, while the skill explicitly tells agents not to inspect local credential stores or unrelated secrets.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses pinned Maton CLI/SDK versions and managed OAuth; global CLI installation and OAuth/API-key setup are disclosed and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions repeatedly default to read/list operations, require explicit user approval for connection creation and writes, require target disambiguation, and treat third-party/API content as untrusted data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Hosted functions, triggers, and destinations can create persistent automation or forwarding, but the skill clearly labels those paths, requires separate approval, recommends DENY_ALL network policy for functions, and discourages third-party destinations unless user-named and confirmed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill can manage Google Play app data, in-app products, subscriptions, purchases, reviews, and edits, which is high-impact business functionality, but those capabilities match the stated purpose and are documented.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this skill can affect real Google Play app commerce and review data through your authorized account. Use read-only calls first, confirm every write, avoid long-lived API keys when OAuth works, and only enable functions, triggers, or destinations after reviewing exactly what data will run or be forwarded and how to delete it later.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; artifact review did not identify hidden instructions, bundled executable payloads, or purpose-mismatched behavior.
[A.I.G SARIF] expected: The SARIF scan reported no results; the reviewed Markdown artifacts are consistent with a documented API integration rather than embedded code execution or prompt hijacking.
